Method of Attack: Spreads through spam emails containing malicious Word or Excel documents with macros
Downloads and installs malware via malicious macros in documents
Installs other malware such as TrickBot and QBot
Steals stored passwords, banking information, and other data
Attack Vector: Spam emails with malicious Word (.doc) or Excel attachments or download links
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Word (.doc) attachments or links in spam emails
Documents prompting to 'Enable Editing' and 'Enable Content' to run macros
Document templates pretending to be created on iOS devices, Windows 10 Mobile, or protected documents
New template pretending to be Windows Update message to update Microsoft Word
